scenes.text: This tutorial covers Installation with pip. Install spaCR in an existing isolated Python environment for desktop or headless use.
Open Installation with pip from the spaCR section. Confirm that the environment uses a supported Python version; Python three point twelve is recommended.
In the main configuration area, upgrade pip if needed and decide whether you need the desktop, development, or optional scientific extras.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. Run pip install spaCR, then verify the command and Python import before starting an experiment.
When the workflow finishes, the same installation can launch the desktop app or run scripted workflows on a workstation or server.
